items.headline: Arash, Unfurl the Morning
items.nudge: Pick one open task; the rest can wait outside the sunbeam.

items.headline: Arash, Keep the Whiskers Up
items.nudge: One task is done; choose the next useful bite, not the loudest one.

items.headline: Arash, Bask in the Quiet
items.nudge: Your list is clear; enjoy the suspiciously peaceful patch of floor.

items.headline: Arash, Crown One Priority
items.nudge: Choose one open task and guard it fiercely from every shiny interruption.

items.headline: Arash, Protect the Winning Thread
items.nudge: Keep the finished momentum small; give one important task your undivided paws.

items.headline: Arash, One Quiet Victory
items.nudge: Nothing remains open; use this calm to jot tomorrow's single priority.

items.headline: Arash, Send One Gentle Ping
items.nudge: Reply to one person with three honest lines; your inbox is not a haunted house.

items.headline: Arash, Share the Tiny Win
items.nudge: Tell someone what moved today, then ask one easy question and exit gracefully.

items.headline: Arash, Let Someone In
items.nudge: With nothing open, send a warm hello before the cat claims all conversation.

items.headline: Arash, Lower the Tiny Bar
items.nudge: Choose the gentlest next step; today does not need a heroic performance.

items.headline: Arash, Keep the Soft Pace
items.nudge: One thing is complete; stop there for a breath, then continue only if kindness agrees.

items.headline: Arash, Rest Without Negotiating
items.nudge: Nothing is open; take the win and let your nervous system sit by the window.

items.headline: Arash, Rescue the Afternoon
items.nudge: Name the one task still tugging your sleeve, then give it fifteen quiet minutes.

items.headline: Arash, Keep the Middle Moving
items.nudge: You have completed something; use that evidence to pick a sensible next step.

items.headline: Arash, Enjoy the Empty Bowl
items.nudge: No tasks are open; spend this pocket on maintenance, curiosity, or excellent snacks.

items.headline: Arash, Tame One Loose Thread
items.nudge: Select one open task, close the tabs, and let everything else become background furniture.

items.headline: Arash, Guard the Deep Work
items.nudge: A task is finished; protect the next focused block from your charmingly unnecessary detours.

items.headline: Arash, Close the Notebook
items.nudge: Everything is closed; capture one idea, then leave the workday's imaginary courtroom.

items.headline: Arash, Unclog One Conversation
items.nudge: Answer one waiting person plainly; brevity is a perfectly respectable social skill.

items.headline: Arash, Pass the Good Pebble
items.nudge: Mention one completed thing to someone you trust and ask how their day is behaving.

items.headline: Arash, Spend the Spare Bandwidth
items.nudge: Your tasks are clear; send one thoughtful reply without accidentally founding a committee.

items.headline: Arash, Make the Afternoon Smaller
items.nudge: Pick the easiest open task and shrink it until even a sleepy cat can start.

items.headline: Arash, Keep What Worked
items.nudge: Something is complete; pause before adding another obligation to the pile.

items.headline: Arash, Claim the Soft Landing
items.nudge: Nothing is open; switch gently to rest, errands, or an unapologetic little treat.

items.headline: Arash, Unsnarl the Evening
items.nudge: Choose one open task to finish or deliberately defer; ambiguity is the real litter box.

items.headline: Arash, Land the Day Gracefully
items.nudge: You finished at least one thing; settle the next step, then stop before midnight auditions.

items.headline: Arash, Admire the Clean Trail
items.nudge: Your tasks are clear; review tomorrow lightly, then let tonight belong to you.

items.headline: Arash, Give One Task Nightlight
items.nudge: Choose one open task for a short closing sprint, with the rest safely ignored.

items.headline: Arash, Finish the Right Thing
items.nudge: One task is done; finish one meaningful thread or park it with a clear note.

items.headline: Arash, Retire the Laser Beam
items.nudge: Nothing is open; turn off focus mode and let your brain stop hunting.

items.headline: Arash, Send the Low Stakes Reply
items.nudge: Reply to one person with a simple truth; elaborate emotional essays can wait until daylight.

items.headline: Arash, Share Before You Snooze
items.nudge: Tell someone one thing you finished today, then invite a tiny, easy response.

items.headline: Arash, Close the Social Loop
items.nudge: Nothing is open; send one goodnight message and leave the rest gloriously unanswered.

items.headline: Arash, Permission to Pause
items.nudge: Open tasks can wait; choose rest tonight, because tired brains make dreadful bargains.

items.headline: Arash, Keep the Evening Kind
items.nudge: You completed something; let that be enough for now and soften the remaining edges.

items.headline: Arash, Fold the Day Away
items.nudge: Nothing is open; close the loop with water, quiet, and absolutely no bonus chores.

items.headline: Arash, Deflate the Midnight List
items.nudge: Choose whether one open task truly matters tonight; the others can nap in the queue.

items.headline: Arash, Bank the Small Win
items.nudge: You completed something; note the next step and let tomorrow inherit the rest.

items.headline: Arash, Leave the List Sleeping
items.nudge: Nothing is open; protect the clean finish and resist inventing a midnight sequel.

items.headline: Arash, One Last Tiny Target
items.nudge: Pick one open task that fits ten minutes, then shut the mental door.

items.headline: Arash, Park the Cleverness
items.nudge: One task is complete; write down the next action and stop polishing the moon.

items.headline: Arash, Power Down the Pointer
items.nudge: Your list is clear; end the hunt and give your attention back to sleep.

items.headline: Arash, Send the Tiny Goodnight
items.nudge: Reply to one person with warmth, then let the rest of the world wait until tomorrow.

items.headline: Arash, Share the Last Win
items.nudge: Tell someone one completed thing, keep it brief, and let the night stay quiet.

items.headline: Arash, Whisper Goodnight
items.nudge: Nothing is open; send a soft goodnight and retire from the internet's nonsense.

items.headline: Arash, Let Tomorrow Handle It
items.nudge: Open tasks can wait until morning; tonight's assignment is simply becoming horizontal.

items.headline: Arash, Keep the Victory Small
items.nudge: You completed something; count it gently, then stop before your brain requests an encore.

items.headline: Arash, Sleep on the Victory
items.nudge: Nothing is open; leave the command center dim and let rest do its quiet work.
